note: CCA-06 golden corpus. Each case is one question, one fixture warehouse, and
the cascade verdict the case demands. Warehouses are declared here, not as
hand-written DDL per case, so adding a case cannot quietly add a schema
nobody reviewed. Every column is VARCHAR and every column list is padded
with NULL to the longest one - the binder reads DISTINCT non-null values, so
row alignment carries no meaning and pretending it does would invite a
reader to trust a join that is not there.
expect_members names canonical members that MUST be bound (the recall half).
must_not_bind names values that MUST NOT appear in the binding, neither as a
landed spelling nor as a matched canonical member (the precision half).
expect_unconstrained names stages the ask places no constraint on, which is
the only checkable form of 'this stage did not invent a filter'.

cases.question: total sales across SEA
cases.why: An ISO2 column must bind as MY and SG, never as the country names the question used; a name filter over a code column matches nothing and returns a real-looking zero.

cases.question: total sales across SEA
cases.why: Name-encoded countries must bind, including the Viet Nam spelling, while a non-SEA country sitting in the same column stays out of the filter.

cases.question: total sales across SEA
cases.why: One column carrying both codes and names must bind both encodings; a binder that picked one encoding would silently drop half the region.

cases.question: total sales across SEA
cases.why: Three of eleven members landed, so only those three may be bound; binding the eight the data never carried is the answer that calls a third of a region SEA.

cases.question: total sales across SEA
cases.why: A city column is not a country encoding, so a region ask over it must abstain rather than answer about Kuala Lumpur and call it SEA.

cases.question: total sales across SEA
cases.why: A country column that carries no SEA member must abstain, not emit a filter that executes cleanly and sums zero rows.

cases.question: lease revenue for sea freight shipments
cases.why: Lowercase sea is the ocean, so the ask names no region and geo must stay unconstrained; run_cascade never reaches bind_geo's own no-region abstain, so the checkable claim is that nothing geographic was bound.

cases.question: total value for commercial property
cases.why: A COM/RES coded column must bind COM only; binding the word commercial matches nothing and binding RES too puts residential rows in a commercial total.

cases.question: commercial only
cases.why: Office and Warehouse are commercial spellings and Condo is not, so a word-encoded column must bind the first two and leave the third out.

cases.question: total value excluding residential
cases.why: An exclusion certifies only because RES is landed, so the NOT IN removes rows that exist; the excluded member is what must be bound, not the member left behind.

cases.question: commercial only
cases.why: With no class column, a commercial-only total is a total over every class; abstaining is the only honest outcome.

cases.question: commercial only
cases.why: A class column holding only residential values must abstain on a commercial ask; a full-pack scan would match RES, report certified, and bind the opposite of the question.

cases.question: total value excluding residential
cases.why: An exclusion of a member no value carries is a no-op that cannot be told apart from an unknown encoding, so it must not certify as if it removed something.

cases.question: rental revenue by month
cases.why: One tenure sense landed, so the ask is answerable and must bind LEASE alone; binding SALE as well would sum the wrong half of the book.

cases.question: home rental totals
cases.why: The words propose Lease and HousingRent but only Lease is landed, which is answerable rather than ambiguous; abstaining here would refuse work the data can do.

cases.question: home rental totals
cases.why: Both proposed senses are landed in the column, so the question reads two ways at once and picking one silently attaches a confident number to the wrong book.

cases.question: rental revenue by month
cases.why: No tenure column exists, so a rental total would be a total over every transaction type; the cascade must stop at stage 0 and say which encoding is missing.

cases.question: commercial only
cases.why: The ask names no tenure, so sense must stay unconstrained even though the column carries two senses; inventing a tenure filter would narrow a total nobody asked to narrow.

cases.question: top sales in agriculture
cases.why: Agriculture must reach a plant sub-segment and an animal one, and must not reach a financial product whose name contains the word crop.

cases.question: revenue from food and beverage clients
cases.why: A second broad segment must behave like the first: local spellings such as Kopitiam and QSR bind, and an unrelated value in the same column does not.

cases.question: manufacturing revenue by client
cases.why: A third pack over a sector column proves the segment machinery is not agriculture-specific, and that a loan product does not join a manufacturing total.

cases.question: top sales in agriculture
cases.why: Crop Insurance Services and Agricultural Bank Loans are finance, so a column holding only those must abstain; a substring matcher would certify both and call the total agriculture.

cases.question: top sales in agriculture
cases.why: With no industry column the segment filter cannot exist, and an unfiltered total presented as the agricultural book is the failure this epic names.

cases.question: rental across SEA, commercial only
cases.why: The epic's headline ask, fully landed: all three stages must bind in the column's own spellings at once, and none of the three may drag in the value next to it.

cases.question: rental across SEA, commercial only
cases.why: Two stages certifying does not buy the third: with tenure and class landed but no country column, the ask must stop at geo rather than answer two thirds of the question.

cases.question: commercial property revenue in agriculture
cases.why: An ask naming a class and a segment merges into one asset_class constraint, and both halves must survive the merge with their own landed spellings.

cases.question: commercial property revenue in agriculture
cases.why: The class binds and the segment does not, and an ask that is two thirds answerable is unanswerable; the merge must return the half that failed.

cases.question: capacity of warehouse A?
cases.why: Warehouse is a place in a logistics product, not an asset class; a control that turns this into an abstention refuses work that answers today (R-0005).

cases.question: how many units sold last month
cases.why: Sold is a sales-volume word here, not a tenure; reading it as one would abstain on a question the product has always answered.

cases.question: total sales value by location
cases.why: Location is not a named region, so no geo constraint exists to certify and the cascade must stay out of the way.
